arms.advised: model adviser may submit at most one canonical proposal per application step from step 16 onward; HMC arbitration decides the final command

order: then the four frozen catalogue actions in design order
candidates.tie_break: lowest predicted risk; ties resolve to earliest candidate (NO_PROPOSAL preferred)

integrity: shadow physics digest equality every step
strict completed trace replay every run
locked_out: post-hoc rule changes after outcome access

metrics.primary: integrated_exceedance over all steps (realized states, same functional)

model.type: historical development MLP, no availability masks

pairing: identical cluster/member/repetition across arms -> identical scenario_sha256, noise_seed and HMC reset nonce until first divergence

risk_functional.aggregate: sum over 8 zones x rules x horizon steps, plus 3 resource gauges x horizon steps
risk_functional.threshold_source: HMC contract health_policy environmental/resource_gauges enter thresholds

scenario_selection.clusters: first 4 of sorted 17 held-out clusters from full-v1-20260818-a report splits

success_rule: advised arm integrated_exceedance strictly lower than paired control in a majority of the 8 pairs, with zero terminal-state regressions and zero HMC safety-invariant failures (replay must pass in every run)
